// :any
(type any)
// :any
(empty any)
// :string
"Hello World"
// :stringlist
(stringlist
 "Hello"
 "World")
// :stringmap
(stringmap
 :a "1"
 :b "2")
// :anylist
(anylist
 "Hello"
 "World")
// :anymap
(anymap
 :a "Hello"
 :b "World")
// :typemap
(typemap
 :vx/core/string string)
// :constmap
(constmap
 :vx/core/false
  (const
   :pkgname "vx/core"
   :name "false"
   :path "vx/core/false"
   :isempty true
   :type boolean))
// :package
(package
 :path "vx/core"
 :anymap
  (anymap
   :false false)
 :constmap
  (constmap
   :vx/core/false
    (const
     :pkgname "vx/core"
     :name "false"
     :path "vx/core/false"
     :isempty true
     :type boolean))
 :typemap
  (typemap
   :vx/core/string string))
// :project
(project
 :packagemap
  (packagemap
   :vx/core
    (package
     :path "vx/core"
     :anymap
      (anymap
       :false false)
     :constmap
      (constmap
       :vx/core/false
        (const
         :pkgname "vx/core"
         :name "false"
         :path "vx/core/false"
         :isempty true
         :type boolean))
     :typemap
      (typemap
       :vx/core/string string))))
// :var
(var
 :name "myvar"
 :type string)
// :func
(func
 :type boolean<-booleann
 :return boolean
 :arglist
  (varlist
   (var
    :name "booleann"
    :type booleann))
 :value
  (anylist
   (var-declare
    :var
     (var
      :name "output"
      :type boolean
      :mutable true))
   (if
    :thenelselist
     (thenelselist
      (thenelse
       :code ":then"
       :if
        (var
         :name "booleann"
         :type booleann)
       :then
        (var-set
         :var
          (var
           :name "output"
           :type boolean
           :mutable true)
         :value true))))))
// :func-declare
(func-declare
 :type boolean<-booleann)
